title: Xerox Star User Interface: An overview
summary: A 1982 Xerox PARC film, presented at CHI '90, in which Star designers David Canfield Smith and Charles Irby give an overview of the Xerox Star interface. It shows the document-centric, icon-and-window office system.
why: Cited as the primary historical demo of the Star UI whenever its influence on the Mac and Lisa or document-centric design is discussed.

quote.text: a more recent look at both the Star 8010 and the Apple Lisa.
